title: Decoding spatial mTOR signalling reveals distinct roles in the tumour microenvironment.
snippet: The tumour microenvironment comprises a variety of cell types that interact with malignant cells, influencing both cancer progression and the patient response to therapy. title: Neuroendocrine prostate cancer converges on a fetal pulmonary neuroendocrine-like program.
snippet: Advanced prostate cancers can relapse as neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC), a treatment-resistant state that is independent of androgen receptor (AR) signaling and whose developmental identity remains unclear.
